F-F1.details: MARKING 12.009x (#2 atom behind p), THERMAL 0.069x, stable 5/5 sections. All 4/4 sub-criteria pass.

F-F2.details: 5/5 compound matches: fch=MARKING, of=MARKING, ef=MARKING, cfh=MARKING, eef=THERMAL. 90.9% of all f-compounds are MARKING (uniform distribution).

F-F3.name: f NEUTRAL carryover run analysis
F-F3.details: Only 1 f-f consecutive pair found (need >= 3). f is ~1% rate, too sparse for carryover analysis.

F-F4.name: f-initial macro-state distribution
F-F4.details: 0 f-initial tokens classified by 49-class execution grammar. f is 100% HT/UN (identification/annotation layer). f never enters the execution grammar — the purest identification atom in the system.

F-F5.name: f->c junction analysis
F-F5.details: f->c junction 10.28x enrichment, 98.6% MARKING in f->c compounds. fch is a compound unit analogous to sh in s-atom.

F-F6.name: CHSH+f compound enrichment
F-F6.details: CHSH+f 82.8% MARKING, 11.75x enrichment vs non-f. Comparable to CHSH+p's 87.4% MON+MARK.

F-F7.name: fch compound family survey
F-F7.details: 2/4 sub-predictions: f->c adjacency 67.9% (< 80% threshold), no category diversity (all MARKING). Failure is INFORMATIVE — f is so uniformly MARKING it overrides diversification. f also bonds with h directly (fh family), not exclusively through c.

F-F8.name: f-compound order sensitivity
F-F8.details: 0/3 testable pairs (fo, fe, fc all N < 5). Data limitation, not structural finding. Controls validated (ck/kc, ek/ke order-sensitive).

F-F9.name: Section gradient
F-F9.details: rho(f, MARKING) = +0.900 (best tracker, passes P1). But |rho(f, THERMAL)| = 0.900 (fails P2, needed <= 0.50). Same anti-THERMAL correlation pattern as s-atom.

F-F10.name: Alternative hypothesis discrimination
F-F10.details: H1 'flag' 4/4 (NEUTRAL 100%, R4 1.58x, pos 0.466, line-1 27.9%). H2 'format' 3/4, H3 'fill' 3/4. H1 wins decisively.

F-F11.name: MARKING injection
F-F11.details: 2/3 positive (ef +100pp, of +100pp; cf +0pp because base already MARKING). Mean delta +66.7pp is enormous where measurable. Technical failure: cf base already saturated.

F-F12.name: Compositional convergence
F-F12.details: 5/5 FULL match — fch=MARKING, ofch=MARKING, of=MARKING, ef=MARKING, cf=MARKING. All compounds 100% MARKING. No h-junction diversification (unlike s-atom). H1 'flag' supported.

hypothesis_scores.H2_format: Rejected — no STAGING signal, MARKING purity too high for mixed prediction
hypothesis_scores.H3_fill: Rejected — no OPERATION signal, 100% HT/UN layer
